import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static int n, t, rx, ry;
    static String[] lab = new String[20];
    static String[] sci = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][] mem = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] cap = new int[250][250];
    static int[] par = new int[250];
    static int[][] dist = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] vis = new int[20][20];
    
    static boolean good(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && lab[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && lab[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }
    
    static void pre() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
                vis[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dist[rx][ry] = 0;
        vis[rx][ry] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.add(rx);
        qy.add(ry);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (good(nx, ny) && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int dfs(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int ptr) {
        if (ptr > t) return 0;
        int ret = mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr];
        if (ret != -1) return ret;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) return dist[x0][y0] >= ptr ? 1 : 0;
        if (dist[x0][y0] <= ptr) return mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[k];
            int ny = y0 + dy[k];
            if (good(nx, ny) && dfs(nx, ny, x1, y1, ptr + 1) == 1) {
                return mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 1;
            }
        }
        return mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 0;
    }
    
    static boolean fml(int s, int tt) {
        Arrays.fill(par, -1);
        par[s] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        qu.add(s);
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int v = qu.poll();
            for (int i = s; i <= tt; i++) {
                if (par[i] == -1 && cap[v][i] > 0) {
                    par[i] = v;
                    qu.add(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return par[tt] != -1;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            lab[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        List<int[]> pos = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> lc = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sc = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                } else if (sci[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && sci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    pos.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    lc.add(lab[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    sc.add(sci[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        int m = pos.size();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        Arrays.fill(mem[i][j][k][l], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            cap[0][i + 1] = sc.get(i);
            cap[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = lc.get(i);
        }
        
        pre();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (dfs(pos.get(i)[0], pos.get(i)[1], pos.get(j)[0], pos.get(j)[1], 0) == 1) {
                    cap[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int flow = 0;
        while (fml(0, 2 * m + 1)) {
            int node = 2 * m + 1;
            int nflow = 1000000;
            while (par[node] >= 0) {
                nflow = Math.min(nflow, cap[par[node]][node]);
                node = par[node];
            }
            node = 2 * m + 1;
            while (par[node] >= 0) {
                cap[par[node]][node] -= nflow;
                cap[node][par[node]] += nflow;
                node = par[node];
            }
            flow += nflow;
        }
        
        System.out.println(flow);
    }
}
